facts.fact: CPJ reports that on 2 November 2026 the Ethiopian Media Authority suspended the registration of The Reporter's publisher indefinitely, covering its Amharic and English editions and digital platforms, for reports it said undermine national interests.

CPJ reports that two days before the 2 November 2026 suspension The Reporter published an editorial, 'Press Freedom Is Not A Luxury!', criticising authorities for treating independent reporting as a national security threat and calling for release of journalists held without charge.

note: The 2026 revocations for Addis Standard and Wazema Radio and the detentions are dated only to the year.
